objective: Test whether state changes inside QQQ/IWM during the first hour predict the SPY complex's afternoon direction strongly enough to trade with UPRO or SPXU.

lesson_carried_forward.mechanism_only: Independent equity segments can reveal information that has not fully diffused into SPY.
not_carried_forward: the prior Breadth Consensus entry condition
the prior rule's favorable years or direction
any threshold inferred from prior returns
any combination with the prior lagged-flow strategy
lesson_carried_forward.why_these_are_new_hypotheses: Each candidate measures a transition between two fixed half-hour states. None conditions on the prior candidate's win/loss record or modifies its signal.

data.signal: Local Alpaca IEX QQQ and IWM 30-minute regular-session bars
data.consolidated_execution_audit: Databento EQUS.MINI UPRO/SPXU BBO-1m where available

synchronized_breadth_acceleration.score: Common nonzero sign of QQQ and IWM acceleration, where each acceleration is its second 30-minute return minus its first 30-minute return
synchronized_breadth_acceleration.trade: UPRO when both markets accelerate upward, SPXU when both accelerate downward, otherwise cash
synchronized_breadth_acceleration.economic_claim: A synchronized change in velocity across growth and small-cap equities is evidence of a market-wide information shock that should continue diffusing into SPY during the afternoon.

consensus_formation_event.score: Common nonzero sign of QQQ and IWM second-bar returns, only when their first-bar return signs disagreed
consensus_formation_event.trade: UPRO when disagreement resolves upward, SPXU when it resolves downward, otherwise cash
consensus_formation_event.economic_claim: Resolution from cross-market disagreement into agreement identifies newly broadening information, unlike static agreement that may already be priced.

leadership_curvature.score: (IWM second-bar return minus QQQ second-bar return) minus (IWM first-bar return minus QQQ first-bar return)
leadership_curvature.trade: UPRO when small-cap leadership is strengthening, SPXU when it is weakening, skip exact ties
leadership_curvature.economic_claim: The change in small-cap versus growth leadership measures expansion or contraction of risk appetite independently of the market's absolute first-hour direction.

prohibited_after_results: change the fixed two-bar observation window
add a magnitude threshold or neutral band
select weekdays, years, directions, volatility states, or symbols
combine these candidates with each other or any prior candidate
evidence_warning: The broader research program has viewed all historical years. Frozen-rule partitions prevent within-test repair but do not create a pristine holdout; a survivor would still require future paper validation.
